info.title: LazyApp API
info.description:
One WhatsApp API for developers, SaaS platforms and businesses.

Every endpoint is Bearer-authenticated with a LazyApp API key, returns JSON, and is scoped to the workspace and mode (`live` or `test`) the key belongs to.

post.description:
Send any supported WhatsApp message type. Set `send_at` to schedule instead of sending now, which returns `202` with a scheduled message id.

`type` defaults to `text`. Address the recipient with `to`, or with `recipient.type`/`recipient.value` to send to a BSUID.

**Required scope:** `messages:send`

402.description: Spending limit or wallet balance exhausted.

403.description: The key lacks the required scope, or is restricted from this phone number.

422.description: Validation failed, or the send was refused. Refusals include a stable `code` — `customer_service_window_closed`, `contact_suppressed`, `marketing_opt_out`, or `no_connection`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Makes this write safe to retry: the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

send_at.description: Schedule for later. Must be in the future.

ttl_seconds.description: Drop the message if it cannot be sent within this window.

body.description: Text body, or media caption fallback.

media_url.description: Public URL LazyApp fetches and uploads.

idempotency_key.description: Legacy body-level dedupe. Prefer the Idempotency-Key header.
